content:
nina: quick flag from onboarding Newton LoRA merge for refunds flow — int4 artifact drops leading '-' on refund amounts ~1.2% of cases

prateek: wow that's bad for customers. example?

nina: expected: "Refund: -$45.00"  observed (int4 merged): "Refund: $45.00" (sign missing)

faye: tokenizer same? or a whitespace token issue?

nina: token ids match between base and merged, but argmax chooses the no-sign token on int4. fp16 merged is OK, int4 baseline without LoRA is OK. points to fold+quant interplay.

quant-bot: auto-quant summary: qrun=newton-q-2026-04-05; mode=int4-perchannel; token-drift=0.016; skewed-tokens=["-","$","0","1","4"]

prateek: can you repro minimal prompt deterministically?

nina: repro script:
```
prompt = "Transaction:\nType: Refund\nAmount: -45.00\nNote:"
for s in [3,4,5]:
  print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=s))
```
All seeds return the signed-off amount without '-' on int4. fp16 returns '-' correctly.

faye: try two ablations: 1) merge in fp32 then quantize, 2) runtime-apply LoRA (no fold) to see if ordering matters.

nina: running both now, will post numbers.

(25m later)

nina: results:
- fp32-merge + naive quant -> drop-rate 0.9%
- runtime-apply-LoRA (fp16 adapter + int4 base) -> drop-rate 0.07%

prateek: runtime-apply wins. customer wants single artifact though.

faye: mitigation ideas: bias-correction on sign token `-` and adjacent `$` token during quant calibration; re-fold with fp32 accumulators; or tiny post-output verifier that checks numeric sign using pattern + model token confidences.

nina: tried per-channel symmetric quant + 512-sample bias-corr focused on sign tokens -> drop-rate 0.12%

prateek: good. can we get under 0.1%? that's likely our GA threshold for monetary accuracy.

nina: added a micro verifier: if pattern "(Refund: )?\$\d+\.\d{2}" detected but original prompt contained '-' then reinstate '-' when the model token confidence for '-' < threshold. effectively reduced observed drops to 0.04% in targeted set.

faye: ok ship a `newton-int4-refund-safe` artifact with eval pack (200 targeted refund prompts + 2k regression samples). include merge script, quant flags, bias-corr seeds, and verifier snippet. Also add an entry in console: metric `refund-sign-loss` with alert threshold <=0.1%.

nina: uploading eval tarball to s3://redwood-evals/newton/newton-int4-refund-safe-2823456789.tgz and adding README with exact commands + seed list.

ops-bot: ENG-ML ticket created ENG-ML-7201 (owner: prateek)

prateek: open follow-up to evaluate making targeted sign-token calibration a standard step for billing-related merges.

nina: already added notes to the artifact README and linked the ticket. tagging @faye for customer SE review. :thumbsup:

faye: LGTM. schedule a 15m sync with SE and ship the artifact after sign-off.

quant-bot: artifact metadata appended: newton-int4-refund-safe (sign-bias correction + verifier)
